newsitem.title: UK: UniChem sees no impact from OFT drug move.
newsitem.headline: UniChem sees no impact from OFT drug move.

text.p: British pharmaceutical wholesaler and retailer UniChem Plc said a government decision to seek removal of price fixing on non-prescription medicines would be immaterial to profitability.
In a statement, the company said 88 percent of wholesale sales were prescription medicines unaffected by the announcement.
It said only three percent of the remainder of sales were represented by over-the-counter (OTC) medicines under Resale Price Maintenance (RPM).
"Of that OTC trade, a significant proportion is in own label which would be unaffected by any change to RPM," UniChem said in a statement.
It said its retail chain Moss Chemists derived "the overwhelming majority of its sales from the dispensing of prescription pharmaceuticals which are unaffected by RPM."
RPM allows wholesalers to set minimum price levels for retail sales of certain over-the-counter medicines.
